environment: Pre-release v1.3.17 validation. Direct supplier contract smoke used the supplied upstream credential without recording it: GET /v1/models listed gemini-omni-1.1-flash; POST /v1/videos used integer duration and an Alias.images single-image data URL string mapped from an image object input; the task completed and GET /v1/videos/{id}/content returned HTTP 200 video/mp4. The first explicitly rejected request used duration as a string and returned HTTP 400 without a task ID; it was corrected once and no accepted task was resubmitted. Local binding tests verify the scalar mapping is explicit per binding, rejects unsupported multi-image input before task creation, and leaves other models' array mappings unchanged. Production v1.3.17 completed immediate deployment with online_verified status and all three production entry points returned HTTP 200. The public docs script badge remains hard-coded to v1.3.16 and is deferred to the next release; this does not affect documented API behavior.
